decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Image of timber enclosure, and IQ Outdoor Living Brochure received: 25/07/2018.
S001 Rev A, S002 Rev A, S003 Rev A, S100 Rev A, S101 Rev A, S200 Rev A, A001 Rev A, A002 Rev A, A100 Rev C, A101 Rev C, and A200 Rev C received: 04/09/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The brickwork to be used in the ground floor extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, and the other materials proposed shall match those specified on the approved drawings.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the first floor side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single-storey side extension with Installation of pergola structure, external AC condenser and addition of small projecting bay to first-floor side elevation.
